title: Reading Practice Test 18 – Environment & Energy
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: thông báo tái chế, e-mail trợ cấp, bài báo có chèn câu, ba đoạn liên kết). Chủ đề: môi trường, năng lượng sạch, tiết kiệm năng lượng.

questions.content: The company has installed solar panels to reduce ------- dependence on fossil fuels.
questions.explanation: Tính từ sở hữu đứng trước danh từ 'dependence' → 'its'. 'it's' = it is.

questions.content: Residents are encouraged to separate recyclable materials ------- regular trash.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'separate A from B' = tách A khỏi B.

questions.content: The city's new recycling program has been ------- successful.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho tính từ 'successful' → 'remarkably' (đáng chú ý).

questions.content: Energy consumption at the factory ------- by 20 percent since the new equipment was installed.
questions.explanation: 'since + mốc quá khứ' → hiện tại hoàn thành 'has decreased'.

questions.content: Plastic bags will no longer be provided at checkout, ------- customers are asked to bring their own.
questions.explanation: Quan hệ nguyên nhân – kết quả (không còn túi nilon nên khách được yêu cầu mang túi) → 'so'.

questions.content: The environmental report must be submitted to the agency no ------- than June 30.
questions.explanation: Cụm cố định 'no later than' = không muộn hơn, chậm nhất là.

questions.content: Wind turbines generate electricity ------- producing harmful emissions.
questions.explanation: 'without + V-ing' = mà không (thải khí độc hại).

questions.content: The mayor praised local volunteers for their ------- to cleaning up the river.
questions.explanation: Sau tính từ sở hữu 'their' cần danh từ; 'commitment to + V-ing' = sự tận tâm với việc gì.

questions.content: ------- in 2010, the Green Earth Foundation has planted over one million trees.
questions.explanation: Rút gọn mệnh đề bị động: (Having been) established in 2010, … → 'Established' (được thành lập).

questions.content: Electric vehicles are becoming ------- popular as battery prices fall.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho tính từ 'popular' → 'increasingly popular' (ngày càng phổ biến).

groups.passage:
Going Green at Harmon Industries

This month, Harmon Industries launched several initiatives to reduce its impact on the environment. First, all office lights ---131--- with energy-efficient LED bulbs. The new bulbs use up to 75 percent less electricity than the old ones.

Second, the company has introduced a program that ---132--- employees who cycle or take public transportation to work. ---133---.

Finally, disposable cups have been removed from all kitchens. Employees are encouraged to bring reusable mugs. ---134---, the company will provide one free mug to every staff member.

questions.explanation: Đèn 'đã được thay' (bị động, việc vừa hoàn thành trong tháng này) → 'have been replaced'.
Động từ trong mệnh đề quan hệ, chủ ngữ 'a program' số ít → 'rewards' (khen thưởng).

options.A: Participants will earn points that can be exchanged for gift cards.
options.C: Parking fees have increased this year.

questions.explanation: Câu chèn giải thích cách chương trình khen thưởng hoạt động (tích điểm đổi thẻ quà tặng).
'To help' (để hỗ trợ) nối việc khuyến khích mang cốc với việc công ty tặng cốc miễn phí. 'However' tạo ý đối lập – không hợp.

groups.passage:
City of Brookfield – Recycling Collection Changes

Starting April 1, recycling will be collected every Tuesday instead of every other Thursday. Please place your blue bins at the curb by 7:00 A.M. on collection days.

Glass bottles and jars must now be placed in the new green bins, which will be delivered to all homes during the last week of March. Plastic bags cannot be recycled and should be placed in the regular trash.

questions.content: What change will take place on April 1?

options.B: Collection will begin earlier in the morning.
options.D: Recycling will be collected more frequently.

questions.explanation: Từ 'every other Thursday' (hai tuần một lần) sang 'every Tuesday' (mỗi tuần) → thu gom thường xuyên hơn.

questions.content: What will residents receive in late March?
questions.explanation: '…the new green bins, which will be delivered to all homes during the last week of March.'

groups.passage:
To: Customers of SunPower Solutions
From: Kevin Wright, Customer Relations
Date: May 20
Subject: Government rebate program

Dear Customer,

We are pleased to inform you that the national government has announced a new rebate program for homeowners who install solar panels. Under the program, eligible homeowners can receive a rebate of up to 30 percent of the installation cost.

To qualify, systems must be installed by a certified company, such as SunPower Solutions, between June 1 and December 31 of this year. Applications for the rebate must be submitted within 60 days of installation.

If you are interested, please contact us to schedule a free home assessment. Because we expect high demand, we recommend booking early.

Sincerely,
Kevin Wright

questions.content: What is the e-mail mainly about?

options.C: Financial support for installing solar panels

questions.explanation: Chương trình hoàn tiền (rebate) của chính phủ cho việc lắp pin mặt trời.

questions.content: What is a requirement for the rebate?
questions.explanation: 'Systems must be installed by a certified company… between June 1 and December 31.'

questions.content: Why does Mr. Wright recommend booking early?

options.B: The company expects a lot of interest.

questions.explanation: 'Because we expect high demand, we recommend booking early.'

groups.passage:
Supermarket Chain Goes Plastic-Free in Produce Section

FreshWay Markets, a chain of 85 supermarkets, announced last week that it will remove all plastic packaging from its fruit and vegetable sections by the end of the year. Instead, produce will be sold loose or in paper bags made from recycled materials. [1]

The decision follows a customer survey in which 70 percent of shoppers said they would prefer to buy groceries with less plastic. [2] FreshWay estimates that the change will eliminate about 400 tons of plastic waste each year.

Some suppliers have raised concerns that fresh produce may spoil more quickly without plastic wrapping. [3] To address this issue, FreshWay is testing special storage shelves that keep fruit and vegetables cool and moist. [4]

questions.content: What is the article mainly about?

options.A: A new line of paper products
options.B: A retailer's plan to reduce plastic

questions.explanation: FreshWay bỏ bao bì nhựa ở khu rau quả – kế hoạch giảm nhựa của nhà bán lẻ.

questions.content: What does FreshWay estimate?

options.A: The number of new stores it will open
options.D: The amount of plastic waste that will be avoided

questions.explanation: '…the change will eliminate about 400 tons of plastic waste each year.'

questions.content: The word "raised" in paragraph 3, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'raised concerns' = nêu lên mối lo ngại → expressed. 'lifted/increased' là nghĩa 'nâng lên, tăng' – bẫy.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Customers will also be able to bring their own reusable bags."
questions.explanation: 'also' bổ sung thêm cách đựng rau quả, nối tiếp câu 'sold loose or in paper bags' → vị trí [1].

groups.passage:
GreenHome Energy Audits

Is your electricity bill too high? A GreenHome energy audit can show you where your home is losing energy.

Standard audit – $150: Inspection of insulation, windows, and doors; written report within 5 days
Complete audit – $250: Standard audit plus a heating and cooling system test and a thermal camera scan; written report within 3 days

Customers who make the improvements recommended in their report within 6 months receive a refund of 50% of the audit fee.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

GreenHome Energy Audit – Summary Report
Client: Mark and Julia Stein, 42 Oak Drive
Audit type: Complete
Date of audit: February 3

Findings
1. Attic insulation is thin; heat loss is significant. Recommendation: add insulation, estimated cost $1,800.
2. Gaps around two windows in the living room. Recommendation: seal gaps, estimated cost $150.
3. Heating system is working efficiently. No action needed.

Estimated annual savings if recommendations are followed: $600

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: info@greenhomeaudits.com
From: Julia Stein
Date: July 15
Subject: Audit refund

Hello,

Your team completed an audit of our home in February. Following your recommendations, we sealed the gaps around our windows in March and added attic insulation in June. I have attached copies of the receipts.

Could you please let me know how we can receive the refund mentioned on your Web site?

Thank you,
Julia Stein

questions.content: What is included only in the Complete audit?
questions.explanation: Gói Complete = Standard + kiểm tra hệ thống sưởi/làm mát + quét camera nhiệt.

questions.content: What did the audit find about the Steins' heating system?
questions.explanation: 'Heating system is working efficiently. No action needed.'

questions.content: How much will the Steins most likely receive as a refund?
questions.explanation: Họ làm gói Complete ($250); hoàn 50% phí kiểm định → $125.

questions.content: What is suggested about the Steins?

options.D: They followed the recommendations within the required period.

questions.explanation: Kiểm định ngày 3/2; họ hoàn tất sửa chữa vào tháng 3 và tháng 6 → trong vòng 6 tháng theo điều kiện hoàn tiền.

questions.content: According to the report, how much could the Steins save each year?
questions.explanation: 'Estimated annual savings if recommendations are followed: $600.'
